title: v0.1 model and loss suite: numerical validation before training
hypothesis: The v0.1 residual U-Net plus the four-term loss suite are numerically sound before any real training: (1) at initialisation the edit is exactly zero and the model preserves [B,1,N] for arbitrary (also non-multiple-of-8) lengths; (2) the measured receptive field is at least 40 ms (~2.5 periods at 65 Hz) so pitch-synchronous micro-structure is observable; (3) every loss term reacts monotonically to the distortion it targets and is invariant to gain where it should be; (4) gradients reach every parameter without NaN on CPU and MPS in FP32; (5) MRSTFT+periodicity+envelope separate a distortion-free pair from a distorted one with a margin > 10x, which is the minimum needed for a training signal to exist.
